artifacts.synopsis: The SJC found the complaint judicially out of order (20-2) because BCO 43-1 permits complaints only against acts of a court of the church, not against actions taken in a congregational meeting; the case involved complainants who alleged minor communicant members were wrongly prevented from voting on accepting their associate pastor's resignation, with concurring and dissenting opinions extensively addressing the question of minor communicant suffrage rights and the scope of BCO 43 jurisdiction.

artifacts.title: Intern preaching without licensure and definition of regular basis

matches.evidence: An intern may complete his internship and test his preaching gift without being licensed, and each presbytery may determine what constitutes preaching on a regular basis.

artifacts.title: Pre-care service counting toward internship year under BCO 19-7

matches.evidence: A presbytery may designate service rendered before a candidate came under care or was licensed—such as service as a ruling elder supply—as fulfilling the internship requirement under BCO 19-16.

artifacts.title: Scope of the extraordinary clause for ordination candidates

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that under BCO 18-2 the extraordinary clause excuses only the six-month membership period, not the session endorsement, the two-month filing deadline, or the one-year internship sequence.
